In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the compressive sensing techniques presented in this thesis can be utilized for estimating the direction and angle of arrival of various type of source signals using a small number antennas.

the CS based DOA techniques proposed in this study are able to estimate the number of sources and their DOAs with high accuracy using a small number snapshots, and are capable of handling non fluctuating as well as fluctuation source signals.
